question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Jubilant
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. 'Overjoyed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jubilant (आनंदित) **- Feeling or expressing great happiness and triumph.

 
 
• **Example:** The team was jubilant after their unexpected victory.
 
 
 
• **Overjoyed (अत्यन्त प्रसन्न)** - Extremely happy.
 
 
• **Example: **She was overjoyed to hear the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'Overjoyed' is the synonym of the given word 'Jubilant'.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Overjoyed'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Terrified (डराहट युक्त) **- Extremely frightened.

 
 
• **Example: **He was terrified of heights and avoided tall buildings.
 
 
 
• **Journeyed (यात्रा की) **- Traveled somewhere.
 
 
• **Example: **They journeyed all through the mountains to reach the shrine.
 
 
 
• **Stunted (विकास-विरुद्ध)** - Having been prevented from growing or developing properly.
 
 
• **Example: **The drought has stunted the growth of crops this year.
